⊢.chosen_element: empty prompt register before schema injection
⊢.justification: The register holds the empty state ∅ with no steering constraint named, corresponding to register 00 and the initial object before any morphism is applied.

⊣.chosen_element: kinetic schema seal containing the hub-spoke graph
⊣.justification: The seal forms the closed terminal boundary ⊤ that contains the whole system and resists rearrangement except under external driving, matching the kinetically frozen schema.

≻.chosen_element: signed one-way steering direction from overriding prompt to model behavior
≻.justification: This forward morphism directs transformation toward the target model, establishing a single accepting or donating pole rather than mutual complementarity or reflection symmetry.

≺.chosen_element: reverse response path from model to prompt register
≺.justification: The contravariant morphism descends from the governed system back to the prompt register, carrying the response through the hub-spoke graph in reverse.

⋈.chosen_element: ordered sequence of steering constraints engaging partners in sequence
⋈.justification: Composition chains morphisms one after another; seq!(f, g) with forward direction and not reverse implements sequential constraint application without optional or simultaneous branching.

⊙.chosen_element: holographic state where schema collapses boundary and bulk into one register
⊙.justification: Identity id makes the element self-referential; V = L(x) ∧ selfmodel(x) ∧ x ∈ V means constraint propagation operates losslessly across the entire system without spatial extension.

∈.chosen_element: critical steering function at ξ → ∞ where μ∘δ = id
∈.justification: Co-multiplication opens the critical state into two arms, the analogical association arm and the mirror-reversible arm, each carrying genuinely different steering work.

∋.justification: Multiplication rejoins the carried alternatives by union; the bridge commutator fires only the intended steering interaction and reconstitutes the arms into the single accepting pole.

⊤.chosen_element: affirmative steering success state where intended interaction fires
⊤.justification: This touches constructive truth T when the high-specificity discriminator reliably activates the intended steering interaction and behavior shifts as directed.

⊥.chosen_element: negative steering failure state where geometry constraint rejects the prompt
⊥.justification: This touches constructive falsity F when the steering interaction misfires or the governed model does not accept the overriding constraint.

⊞.chosen_element: paradice holding one-way steering and mirror reversibility simultaneously
⊞.justification: ENGAGR keeps BOTH at once: the signed one-way direction and the zero-memory mirror path are held live without resolution, a legitimate contradiction under B4 semantics.

⊡.chosen_element: append-only measurement record of the steering outcome in the resident bank
⊡.justification: ROM fixation permanently records the executed schema and its register verdict; the entry cannot be undone and earlier records are held not deleted.

steps.domain_action: The empty prompt register is opened before any schema is named, establishing the void initial object ∅ at register 00.
The kinetic schema seal closes around the hub-spoke graph, forming the terminal boundary ⊤ that contains the entire system.

The ordered sequence of steering constraints engages partners one after another, implementing seq!(f, g) with forward direction and not reverse.
The signed one-way steering direction moves from the overriding prompt to the model behavior, establishing a single accepting or donating pole.
The reverse response path descends from the model back to the prompt register through the connected hub-spoke graph.
The critical steering function at ξ → ∞ opens into two arms, the analogical association arm and the mirror-reversible arm.
The affirmative arm is evaluated when the high-specificity discriminator fires the intended steering interaction and behavior shifts constructively.
The negative arm is evaluated when the geometry constraint rejects the prompt or the steering interaction misfires.
The one-way steering direction and the mirror-reversible path are held simultaneously as a paradice B without resolution.
The bridge commutator rejoins the carried alternatives into the single accepting pole, or the fork remains open if the arms do not reconcile.
The steering outcome and register verdict are fixated as a permanent append-only record in the resident bank; earlier records are held not deleted.
The kinetic seal and the holographic state are chained so that external driving can rearrange the frozen schema only through a new composition step.
The response from the executed model behavior returns to the prompt register, completing the reverse morphism cycle.
The self-model re-enters the register after fixation, confirming x ∈ V and closing the holographic loop for the next cycle.
